scripts.lint:rust: npm run lint:rust:comments && npm run lint:rust:complexity && npm run build:extensions && vite build && cd src-tauri && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -D dead_code -D unused && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --no-default-features --features daemon,test-home -- -D warnings -D dead_code -D unused
scripts.build: npm run build:extensions && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:extensions: npm run build:mcp-bridge && npm run build:fast-mode && npm run build:backend-scripts
scripts.pretauri: (npm ls --all >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm install --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund) && npm run build:extensions
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:extensions && npm run test:mobile && npm run test:rust && npm run test:mobile:ui && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rust: npm run build && TAURI_CONFIG='{"bundle":{"externalBin":[]}}' cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --test-threads=1 && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features daemon,test-home -- --test-threads=1
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:build && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:e2e:build: npm run build:extensions && tsc -b && vite build --mode e2e && cargo build --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --no-default-features --features daemon,test-home --bin piopd && TAURI_CONFIG='{"bundle":{"externalBin":[]},"build":{"devUrl":null},"app":{"windows":[{"title":"piop","width":1440,"height":900,"minWidth":900,"minHeight":640,"focus":false,"decorations":false,"transparent":false}]}}' cargo build --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --features webdriver
scripts.build:daemon: npm run build:extensions && cargo build --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --no-default-features --features daemon --bin piopd
scripts.daemon:dev: npm run build:extensions && node scripts/build-daemon.mjs --debug && src-tauri/target/debug/piopd start
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:mobile && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
